query:
SELECT cfs.id, cfs.conversationId, cfs.flowId, cfs.currentNodeId, cfs.context, cfs.status, cfs.startedAt 
FROM chatFlowSessions cfs 
JOIN conversations c ON c.id = cfs.conversationId 
WHERE c.customerName LIKE '%Matheus%' 
ORDER BY cfs.startedAt DESC LIMIT 3
